data-reference.name: Data Reference
data-reference.description: Skills that fetch and use information from databases, APIs, and external sources
bestPractices: Allow only read-only tools for safety
Specify caching strategy for performance optimization
Clearly document data formats and schemas
data-reference.exampleDescription: Helps write queries by referencing SQL database schemas

workflow-automation.name: Workflow Automation
workflow-automation.description: Skills that automate repetitive tasks and improve efficiency
bestPractices: Include a state verification step before the task
workflow-automation.exampleDescription: Automates Git commit message writing and PR creation

code-analysis.name: Code Analysis
code-analysis.description: Skills that analyze code quality, security, and performance and suggest improvements
bestPractices: Clearly define the analysis scope and criteria
Output results in a structured format
code-analysis.exampleDescription: Analyzes potential bugs and improvements in the codebase

documentation.name: Documentation
documentation.description: Skills that generate and manage code, API, and project documentation
bestPractices: Analyze existing documentation style for consistency
Track version info and update history
documentation.exampleDescription: Automatically generates JSDoc/TSDoc comments for functions and classes

testing.name: Testing
testing.description: Skills that support test code generation, execution, and coverage analysis
bestPractices: Include edge cases and boundary value tests
testing.exampleDescription: Automatically generates unit tests for existing code

categorySelector.title: Select Template Type

basicInfoForm.title: Enter Basic Info
basicInfoForm.subtitle: Enter the name and description for your skill. The description is used by Claude to determine when to invoke the skill.
basicInfoForm.skillIdHint: Leave blank to auto-generate from name:
basicInfoForm.descriptionTip: Tip: Including trigger keywords like "when doing X" or "during X task" helps Claude activate the skill at the right time.

toolSelector.title: Select Tools
toolSelector.subtitle: Choose the Claude Code tools your skill can use. Leave empty to allow all tools.

templatePreview.title: Preview

leastPrivilege.title: Least Privilege Principle
leastPrivilege.description: Allow only the tools you need to improve safety. If only reading is needed, allow only Read, Grep, and Glob.
